text:
julia: FYI Orchid Analytics (acct: OA-927) reported a bounced outbound wire. Payment id: pay_21X7. Bank returned: 'Unknown correspondent BIC: ABCDUS33BRN' — looks like a branch suffix got appended. Can ops pick this up?

mark: Looking at the settlement report: return code N07 - 'No account / unregistered bank'. MT103 shows 57A: ABCDUS33BRN. Our validator allowed an 11+ char token. Downstream bank expects canonical 8/11 BICs without ad-hoc branch tags.

kiran: Quick repro steps: grabbed the raw MT103 from our queue, ran our existing normalizer (only trims whitespace). The BIC made it through as-is. I can reproduce with: `raw_bic = 'ABCDUS33BRN'` -> accepted. Need to strip trailing branch identifiers like BRN or region codes.

julia: @mark can you confirm whether manual resubmit with corrected correspondent BIC will clear this? Customer needs funds same day if possible.

mark: Bank support confirmed they will reprocess if we send corrected correspondent BIC plus original trace id. I'll prepare manual resubmit once we have the corrected value. ETA ~2 hours. :thumbsup:

anthea: Please prioritize — Orchid needs a remittance confirmation for their AP team.

kiran: Proposed quick fix (pattern-based) to avoid future slips: 
```
# naive BIC cleanup
bic = bic_raw.strip().upper()
bic = re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9]', '', bic)
# remove common trailing branch tags (BRN, BR, HDR, BR-01)
bic = re.sub(r'(BRN|BR|HDR|BR\-\d{2})$', '', bic)
# ensure length is 8 or 11
if len(bic) not in (8,11):
    bic = bic[:8] if len(bic) >= 8 else bic
```
I can ship as a hotfix to the payment-normalizer service; it'll also emit a warning metric for stripped suffixes.

mark: Ops note: manual resubmit done w/ corrected BIC (ABCDUS33). Bank accepted the reprocessing request; monitoring for settlement. Also created a reconciliation row for pay_21X7 to track any fees. @billing-bot tagging for fee waiver.

billing-bot: New ticket created: INV-4927 (fee waiver request for pay_21X7).

julia: Next steps captured: (1) manual resubmit (done) (2) run a one-off search for queued/settled items with nonstandard BIC suffixes and flag (3) deploy hotfix to normalizer with warnings + metric (4) customer outreach template. I'll file a short postmortem in #incidents after settlement clears.

mark: Settlement received confirmation from bank, funds delivered to beneficiary.

anthea: Confirmed funds landed and accounting reconciled. Thanks everyone :tada:
